$Comment: A costume: for three minutes the wearer takes the game's turkey look (the model Turkey). It changes the model and is no debuff, which is what makes it a costume: the wearer can take it off any time with /zigcostume off, and no second costume goes over it. The host puts it on a player who comes back from the turkey hunt, the second quest, through the Costume reward kind. Duration is in seconds.
Name: harvestfeast.world.effect.harvest_feast_costume_turkey.name
